source_authority: The supplied first and last frames are exact endpoint authorities. They show a flat, anti-aliased Internet Explorer 7 style toolbar on a pale pink-and-white vertically striped ground: a gold favorites star, a green add-to-favorites star, one white parallelogram tab with the four-colour Windows flag and the label 'Windows Live', and to its right the short blank New Tab stub. In the last frame a second identical white tab reading 'Blank Page' with a grey page icon stands where the stub was, and a fresh stub sits to its right. Every icon, letterform, stripe, border line, and tab edge in these frames is the identity; reproduce them exactly.
style_lock: flat, thin-outlined 2006-era Windows toolbar drawing: white tab faces, one-pixel grey outlines, slanted parallelogram tab sides, pale pink vertical stripes on the bar and around it
the gold star, the green star with the white plus, the Windows flag, and the 'Windows Live' label stay pixel-stable for the whole clip
the stripe pattern, the top and bottom border lines of the bar, and the empty area to the right stay perfectly still
no shading, gloss, gradients, drop shadows, glow, blur, or modern rounded-corner restyling
typography is the dark grey sans-serif of the source; no new words, no letter changes beyond the two labels named in the motion
motion: This is a two-frame user interface state change, drawn the way Internet Explorer 7 drew it in 2008: hard cuts between held poses, with nothing sliding, growing, or fading. Three held poses. Pose one, from the start until about 35 percent of the clip: exactly the first frame. One tab reading 'Windows Live', the short blank stub to its right, the two stars on the left. Everything is static; the stub may be read as being clicked, but no cursor is drawn and nothing highlights. Pose two, beginning at about 35 percent, arriving in a single frame with no in-between drawing: the stub has become a second full-height white tab of the same parallelogram shape as the first, standing exactly where the stub stood, showing a small grey page icon on its left and the label 'Connecting...' in the same dark grey sans-serif, and a fresh short stub has appeared to the right of it. The 'Windows Live' tab does not move, resize, or change. This pose is held, completely still, for about 0.6 seconds, roughly 35 to 60 percent of the clip. Pose three, beginning at about 60 percent, again arriving in a single frame: the label on the second tab is replaced by 'Blank Page'. The icon, tab shape, first tab, stars, stub, and stripes are unchanged. Pose three is held, completely still, until the last frame, which is identical to the supplied last frame. Between poses there is no motion: no width growing from zero, no sliding out from behind the first tab, no opacity fade, no bounce, no cursor, no tooltip. Each transition is a one-frame swap, exactly like the reference recording.
timing: Hold pose one for the first 35 percent. Cut to pose two at 35 percent in one frame. Hold pose two, static, until 60 percent. Cut to pose three at 60 percent in one frame. Hold pose three, static, through the final frame. There is no easing because there is no interpolated motion; the only timing that exists is the length of each hold.
camera: Locked orthographic front view of the toolbar, framing identical to the supplied frames. No pan, zoom, roll, parallax, reframing, depth of field, or vignette.
background: Use the exact pale pink-and-white vertical stripe ground present in the endpoint frames, above, below, and to the right of the bar. It stays perfectly still; no drift, shimmer, gradient, or colour change.
